candidates.change_summary: Pass tx.origin instead of msg.sender as the oracle owner so the deployed oracle's owner() observable value differs.
Remove the transferOwnership call so the oracle keeps the default owner (msg.sender from Ownable constructor) instead of the explicitly passed owner, observable via owner() when they differ.
Emit address(0) as the owner in the NewEmergencyOracle event instead of msg.sender, changing the event data observable off-chain.
Invert the admin check so non-admins can call and admins are rejected, changing which calls to newEmergencyOracle revert.
